rappel_detail.anchor: not described; carry a rope and slings
rappel_detail.station: The crux headwall band below the summit block, at the corniced step above the Tailgunner Couloir.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional short rappel, made only in early-season snow or cornice conditions; on the dry Class 3 line parties downclimb.
hazards: A cliff band just north of Tailgunner Pass blocks a direct descent; do not leave the ridge early.
